The University of Benin has been thrown into mourning following the death of a 100-level Engineering student, identified as Omorodion Japheth, who reportedly collapsed while playing football at the university’s Sports Complex. Japheth was said to have slumped during a football match on Friday, November 13, 2026, prompting efforts by fellow students and others at the facility to revive him. According to an eyewitness, who pleaded anonymity because of the sensitive nature of the incident, first aid was administered before the deceased was rushed to the university’s health centre, where he was subsequently confirmed dead. The eyewitness said heatstroke, resulting from intense heat and physical exertion, might have caused the deceased’s death. The source said, “Japheth collapsed while playing football, and I think it was due to the intense heat. The other players tried to revive him, but he was pronounced dead when he was taken to the school’s medical centre.” Jackson scores as Senegal move closer to 2027 AFCON Edo moves to tackle 129 erosion sites Edo moves to tackle 129 erosion sites While the exact circumstances surrounding his death remain unclear, no official medical confirmation of the cause of death had been made public as of the time of filing this report. In honour of the deceased, the Nigerian Universities Engineering Students’ Association, UNIBEN Chapter, has announced plans to organise a candlelight procession in his memory. The procession is scheduled for Monday at 6pm at the Engineering Car Park. Members of the university community attending the event have been encouraged to wear black in tribute to the deceased. Japheth’s death has thrown his family, friends, fellow students and the university community into mourning. Adeyinka Adedipe
